reasoning_content: The awscli install is broken - lacks `.mise-bins`. Let me try reinstalling awscli fresh. Also 1password-cli plugin updated and its install path may have changed. Let me remove and reinstall those two.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && FILTER='vfox|stack|require|C\]:|crates|no field|no file|can.t load'; mise uninstall awscli 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -3; rm -rf /root/.local/share/mise/installs/awscli; timeout 300 mise install awscli 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -5; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; mise which aws 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -2
